welcome.accountSubtitle: Stays on this machine. No email is sent, ever.
welcome.emailHint: Only used as your local login name.
welcome.accountWhy: Kilnry needs a local session to protect your keys, especially if you later allow network access. Nothing is uploaded.
welcome.terminalTitle: Open the setup link from your terminal
welcome.terminalBody: Run pnpm dev and open the one-time link it prints.
welcome.librarySubtitle: Everything you create lands here as files you own, with a small metadata file beside each one.
welcome.libraryDocker: This path is set by your Docker volume.
welcome.providerTitle: Add one key to generate for real
welcome.providerSubtitle: Kilnry tests the key before saving it. You can also use a free Pollinations key or continue without a provider.
welcome.providerPlaceholder: Paste a key. Kilnry detects the provider.
welcome.providerAmbiguous: This key prefix is shared. Choose Pollinations for the free image demo.
welcome.providerHelp: Keys are encrypted on this machine and never returned by the API.
welcome.providerError: Kilnry could not test that key. Check it and try again.
welcome.demo: Try the demo with a free Pollinations key
welcome.demoBody: Kilnry ships no keys. Create a free Pollinations key, then paste it above with Pollinations selected.
welcome.demoNote: Free image-only generation may include a provider watermark. Add fal or OpenRouter later for video and more models.
welcome.recoveryBody: This is shown once. Save it in a password manager or on paper; never share it.
welcome.readyBody: Your Library and provider choices are saved. Kilnry is ready to make a first image.
welcome.passwordWeak: That password is easy to guess. Add words or symbols.
welcome.emailInvalid: Enter an email address. It's only used as your login name.
welcome.genericError: Kilnry couldn't save this step. Check the details and try again.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Kilnry adds nothing to provider prices. Keys stay encrypted on this machine and every spend is priced before submit.
providers.keyLabel: Add or replace a provider key
providers.keyPlaceholder: Paste a key. Kilnry detects the provider.
providers.encryptionHelp: Pick a provider when the key format is ambiguous.
providers.ambiguous: This prefix is shared by providers. Select the issuer before testing.
providers.testFailed: The provider rejected the connection test.
providers.requestFailed: Kilnry could not update Provider settings.
providers.controlsSaved: Provider limits saved. Concurrency applies after restart.
providers.falHelp: Images, video, audio, transforms, and training
providers.openrouterHelp: Images, video, transcription, and language models

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.subtitle: The Library is an ordinary folder. Sidecars are the source of truth and the database is a rebuildable index.
workspace.libraryBody: Rebuild scans files and sidecars, recovers embedded PNG metadata, and replaces only the Library index.
workspace.reindexFailed: Kilnry could not rebuild the Library index.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Provider keys use envelope encryption: one random data key, wrapped by a master key that never enters the database.
security.machineWarning: Machine-derived protection is weaker. It protects a copied data folder, not an attacker running as you.
security.lockedBody: The original keychain entry is missing. Enter the recovery kit to unlock the encrypted keys without re-entering them.
security.kitIntro: Your recovery kit re-creates the key that protects provider keys if this machine's keychain is lost. View it, store it safely, and never share it.
security.kitSaveBody: It is not stored in plaintext and will disappear when you close this panel.
security.confirmGroups: To prove the backup is readable, re-enter these two four-character groups.
security.networkOff: Off. Kilnry accepts connections only from this machine.
security.networkPending: LAN access will turn on after Kilnry restarts. Use HTTPS or a trusted private network.
security.networkActive: LAN access is active. Keep Kilnry on a trusted network and prefer Tailscale Serve or HTTPS.
security.networkPassword: Current password for LAN access change
security.sessionsBody: Review browsers that can open this local studio and revoke anything you no longer use.
security.loadFailed: Kilnry could not load the key-encryption status.

appearance.subtitle: Choose how Kilnry looks and moves on this machine. Changes apply immediately and persist across restarts.
